correlationEnergyPolicy: Record both RMS values; directly recompute low-energy candidate power and cross products; discard lag candidates >60 dB below reference energy; never clamp coefficients. Only both-window RMS below -120 dBFS is uninformative.

loudness.measurement: ffmpeg loudnorm input measurement on final encoded audio

limitations: Synchronization conclusion is decoded-waveform matching at 0.125 ms search resolution; not based only on stream metadata.
AAC is lossy and is not expected to match PCM samples exactly.
No subjective music listening or aesthetic approval is implied.
Silent windows do not carry timing evidence and are listed separately.
